topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I walk softly around the edges, eyes darting, muscles tense. They took my words, the ones I woven carefully, as if I had laid out the finest thread from my own heart, and now they hang there for all to see. I did not mean for it, this openness. Shadows feel longer, the path ahead less clear. I am careful, so careful. What if they see in my words more than I meant to show? What if this Changes things, opening doors I cannot close, inviting others to step too close? I stay back, watching, hoping the storm will pass without notice.
